title: The help flag always prints help and never runs the command
description: Reported 2026-11-05 through Ryan: 'papyrus ops content list articles --help' printed the article list instead of help, and 'papyrus ops content --help' said unsupported command. Earlier today, --help on several 'references' and 'knowledge entities' commands printed nothing. Because mutation commands write by default, --help on a write command could perform the write. Every command and group answers --help and -h with its usage and does nothing else.
